description: Returns every tool in one Resources category, list by list, lowest price first as on the page: price at the list's scale (or entry price), free option, API access, official MCP server, audience, and a link to its card. Sourced values carry their source URL; null means the vendor does not say.

category.description: Category id, page slug, or name from gv_list_tool_categories, e.g. email

subcategory.description: One list in the category, by its exact name

name: gv_list_tools
title: List the tools in a category
